text: AO T-Industriya built a controlling stake of about 75% in AO BetElTrans (concrete sleeper manufacturer): it bought 50% minus 2 shares in 2014, and in March 2017 RZD's board resolved to sell it a further 25% for 1.5 billion rubles.
short: T-Industriya owns about 75% of BetElTrans since 2017

source.name: Vedomosti: Компания, связанная с сыном генпрокурора Игорем Чайкой, получит 75% крупнейшего производителя шпал
source.quote: «Т-индустрия» уже владеет 50% минус 2 акции «Бетэлтранса» – пакет она купила в 2014 г. за 3 млрд руб.
source.note: English: 'T-Industriya already owns 50% minus 2 shares of BetElTrans; it bought the package in 2014 for 3 billion rubles.' Same article reports RZD's board resolved to sell a further 25% for 1.5 billion rubles. Whether RZD's residual ~25% stake was sold later is unverified.

additionalSources.name: Kommersant: РЖД продает шпалы
additionalSources.quote: В 2014 году 50% минус две акции БЭТ за 3,025 млрд руб. купило АО "Т-Индустрия".
additionalSources.note: English: 'In 2014, AO T-Industriya bought 50% minus two shares of BET for 3.025 billion rubles.'
